articles.nri_angle: Air India's cost drive under its new CEO will shape fares, service and reliability on the long-haul routes the diaspora flies most.

articles.title: Indian Airlines Extend Saudi Suspensions, IndiGo Cancels Till November 14
articles.excerpt: Air India and Air India Express keep Riyadh and Dammam suspended till November 7 and Jeddah till October 31, while IndiGo's Saudi cancellations now run to November 14 — with refunds and one free rebooking for bookings made on or before October 24.
articles.nri_angle: Hundreds of thousands of Indian workers and Umrah travellers use these Saudi routes; the staggered suspension dates and the October 24 booking cutoff decide who gets a free rebooking or a full refund.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Says Direct Taiwan Flights Will Fly Despite Pakistan Airspace Row
articles.excerpt: Pakistan barred China Airlines and EVA Air citing the 'One China' policy, then reversed course within hours — as EVA Air prepares to launch nonstop Delhi-Taipei flights on December 1.
articles.nri_angle: The nonstop restores a direct link for the Indian business, student and family traffic that has connected through Bangkok, Hong Kong or Singapore since 2020, and gives US- and Canada-based travellers a Taipei-hub option to Delhi.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Tawang Hosts International Tourism Mart With Buyers From 22 Countries
articles.excerpt: The 14th International Tourism Mart runs October 29-31 at Hotel Vivanta, Tawang, with over 200 participants and 43 international buyers, returning to Arunachal Pradesh for the first time since 2013.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora travellers in buyer markets including the US, UK and Australia, combined North East circuits packaged at the Mart — and the session on Protected and Restricted Area access — determine how bookable a Tawang itinerary becomes from abroad.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Mumbai Airport Network Outage Delays Flights, Forces Manual Check-In
articles.excerpt: A network disruption at CSMIA on Tuesday evening hit check-in, e-gates and DigiYatra for over an hour: 18 of 44 departures between 7 pm and 9 pm left at least an hour late and three were cancelled.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora travellers connecting through Mumbai's Terminal 2 or starting long-haul journeys there, the outage is a reminder to check airline status before leaving, allow manual check-in time, and carry offline booking copies when DigiYatra is down.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Deepavali in Singapore: Little India's 2km Light-Up, Festival Village and What to Do Before Nov 8
articles.excerpt: Serangoon Road's lights run nightly until November 29, the Campbell Lane Festival Village closes on Deepavali itself, and the Indian Heritage Centre's Open House, diya painting and free concerts fill the final week.
articles.image_caption: Performers stage a street performance in Little India during the Deepavali season in Singapore. More than 2km of lights run along Serangoon Road nightly until November 29, and the Festival Village stays open until Deepavali on November 8.
articles.nri_angle: Singapore's Little India runs one of the largest Deepavali celebrations outside India, and this guide gives diaspora readers the exact dates, hours and free events to plan around before November 8.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Indians Travelling to UAE Advised to Take Medical Insurance With Repatriation Cover
articles.excerpt: India's missions in Abu Dhabi and Dubai issued the advisory after receiving several cases of travellers facing huge hospital bills they could not pay. Cover should be bought before travel, include cashless treatment, and cover medical repatriation to India.
articles.image_caption: Dubai International Airport. Indians travelling to the UAE have been advised to take medical insurance with repatriation cover.
articles.nri_angle: Families visiting relatives in the UAE are the group most often caught without cover; residents should also verify their existing policies.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Air India Unveils India-Inspired Amenity Kits and Loungewear for Long-Haul Premium Passengers
articles.excerpt: Gond art, Navratna colours, a wooden Marma massager and Kullu-inspired loungewear arrive on flights over eight hours from October 2026
articles.image_caption: An Air India aircraft. The airline has unveiled India-inspired amenity kits and loungewear for long-haul premium passengers
articles.nri_angle: US, European and Australian diaspora travellers on India routes over eight hours are the passengers who will actually receive the new First and Business Class kits, massager and loungewear, and the refreshed Premium Economy kit.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Digi Yatra International Trials Start November 1 at Seven Airports
articles.excerpt: Indian nationals with e-passports flying Air India or IndiGo can test face-based entry, security and boarding — immigration and document checks stay unchanged.
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora travellers holding Indian e-passports and flying Air India home can use the faster lane, while OCI and foreign-passport travellers remain outside this trial.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Diwali 2026 in Dubai: Where to Shop, What to Buy and How Not to Overspend
articles.excerpt: Meena Bazaar for outfits and diyas, the Deira Gold Souk on Dhanteras, and a Dubai Jewellery Group campaign with 1 kg of gold in raffles running October 24 to November 12 — a practical guide for the Gulf diaspora, with Diwali on Sunday, November 8.
articles.nri_angle: Dubai's Indian community is one of the largest in the Gulf; this guide maps its Diwali shopping geography and the dates that matter.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Air India and IndiGo Cut Europe Flights as Winter Capacity Falls 6.5% — and Foreign Carriers Take the Passengers
articles.excerpt: Air India ends Delhi-Vienna and its Birmingham services and IndiGo has suspended Manchester and will pause Heathrow, as India-Europe winter seats fall to 5.63 million; longer routings around closed airspace and high fuel costs are driving the cuts.
articles.image_caption: An Air India aircraft in flight. Air India and IndiGo are cutting Europe capacity this winter as foreign carriers take a larger share of passengers.
articles.nri_angle: Fewer nonstops mean diaspora travellers between India and Europe face more one-stop itineraries via Gulf and European hubs this winter — book early for Diwali and Christmas peaks.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Air India Launches Only Direct Toronto-Mumbai Flight for Winter Season
articles.excerpt: Seasonal AI193/AI192 service runs three times weekly from October 25 to March 26 on an upgraded Boeing 777-300ER, adding nearly 2,000 seats a week between Canada and India.
articles.image_caption: An Air India aircraft. Air India is launching the only direct Toronto-Mumbai flight for the winter season.
articles.nri_angle: The only direct Toronto-Mumbai link gives GTA families a non-stop option to western India for the winter festive and holiday season without a Delhi or third-hub connection.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Air India Launches Restaurant-Style Fine Dining in Business Class
articles.excerpt: The course-by-course service, with linen tables and bespoke Vista Verve tableware, has launched on India-UK routes and will expand across the A350, 787-9 and 777-300 fleets.
articles.image_caption: Boeing 777-337ER - Air India (VT-ALK). Air India announced on October 22 a restaurant-style, course-by-course fine dining service for Business Class on select long-haul and ultra-long-haul flights.
articles.image_credit: Photo: Eluveitie via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 3.0)
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora travellers in Business Class on India-UK flights are the first to get the new dining service, with US and other long-haul routes to follow as it expands across the widebody fleet.

articles.title: Diwali Fares Are Peaking: When to Book, When to Stop Waiting
articles.excerpt: With Diwali on November 8, last-minute fares on busy routes are already two to four times off-peak levels - flexibility on dates, airports and split tickets is now worth more than any coupon.
articles.nri_angle: For US-based readers connecting onward in India, shifting the domestic leg off peak days and setting fare alerts on both legs is the remaining way to contain Diwali costs.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Auckland's Diwali Festival Returns October 31 With Fireworks, Sky Tower Lights
articles.excerpt: The free BNZ Auckland Diwali Festival takes over Aotea Square and Queen Street on October 31 and November 1, with the Sky Tower lit from October 23 and Sunday fireworks at 8:50pm.
articles.image_caption: Auckland's Sky Tower lit in the Indian tricolour at night (file photo, PMO India). The tower lights up again for the city's Diwali festival, which returns on October 31 with fireworks.
articles.nri_angle: One of the Southern Hemisphere's largest Diwali celebrations, and a ready-made itinerary anchor for Indian travellers and New Zealand's Indian community in Auckland.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
